title: Hello!
text:
Hi, I’m Reinout
I’m a 2nd-year Master’s student at UHasselt in Statistics & Data Science, with a focus on Bioinformatics. My main interests are programming, data science/visualization and bioinformatics (microbiome and genetics). I also can write JavaScript and react, so I am comfortable with html files, the command line, and working on bigger projects using Github.
For example, take a peep at this interactive dashboard about about air pollution that Sophie and me made last year for our data visualization course! https://dataviz-5zhh.onrender.com/.
In my free time, I like to:
- Go to the gym
- Cook and experiment in the kitchen
- Play the mouth harmonica (my neighbors and girlfriend have mixed feelings)
- Learn about horses and other random topics
- Travel (if my wallet allows)
